get_loss_fun: get the configured loss function instance and move it to the CUDA device
review_get_loss_fun: review the get_loss_fun function to understand how it retrieves and returns the configured loss
refactor_get_loss_fun: refactor get_loss_fun to support additional loss functions beyond cross entropy
summarize_LOSS_FUNS: summarize the _LOSS_FUNS dictionary mapping loss names to PyTorch loss classes
test_get_loss_fun: test the get_loss_fun function with different cfg.MODEL.LOSS_FUN config values
